text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing... I can hardly believe it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I... I finished ahead of
both Tama-chan and Oguri-chan...!
choice_data_list: This is what I'm capable of.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aww~.
You're flattering me way too much~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, being able to wrap it up in good shape...
makes me truly happy.”

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, care to give a post-race comment?
Right this way!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Thank you very much
for coming to our race today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This past year, because of my own presumption, I have caused you so much trouble, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Still, I feel like this was a trial meant to help both of them grow."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Super Creek, what is your next goal?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, we'll discuss it and decide together, but
I was hoping the two of us could run in our dream race, the Osaka Hai~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We still have much to learn,
but we look forward to working with you next year as well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, what kind of ceremony is that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Man, I can't catch a break. Right, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's let 'em have the glory for today, though.
The real battle starts from here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Just so you know, no whining about being hungry later, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't have anything like that!

Despite all the commotion around her,
the final day of the year turned out to be an exquisite one for Super Creek.
